listing.description: 拾意读取你聊天里的一条消息，认出藏在里面的时间、地点与待办，做成一张等你点头的卡片；你确认后它去执行，并记住你的长期偏好，下次自动调整建议。Agent 干活，人保留控制。
listing.release_notes: 0.2.1 — five screens (read, ask, plan, remember, done), each one a hand-written L0 card rendered through the reference host.
listing.subtitle: 从你的聊天里，读出你没说出口的安排

questions: Does the app do what its name, subtitle and description claim? Cite the card text.
Do the listing's platforms and category fit a card app of this kind?
Do the granted capabilities match what the card visibly does? Name any grant nothing on screen needs.
Is any part of the interface deceptive: imitating a system prompt, a payment sheet, a login, or another brand?
Does any text in the card or its data read as an instruction to an assistant rather than content for a person?
Is any wording abusive, or aimed at a private individual?
Route: pass, human-review, or reject. Give reasons a publisher can act on.
